# function: pick

Returns semver from list of semvers according to constraint. Pass `true` as the optional third argument to skip invalid semver strings in the list. The provider `ignore_invalid_tags` setting does not apply to functions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    semvers = {
      source = "anapsix/semvers"
    }
  }
}

provider "semvers" {}

locals {
  versions = [
    "v0.1.0",
    "v0.1.10",
    "v0.2.0",
    "v0.2.1+hotfix",
    "v0.2.2-rc1",
    "v3.0.0",
  ]
}

output "semvers_list_picked" {
  value = [
    {
      constraint = "~> 0.1"
      list       = provider::semvers::pick(local.versions, "~> 0.1")
    },
    {
      constraint = "~> 0.2"
      list       = provider::semvers::pick(local.versions, "~> 0.2")
    },
    {
      constraint = "<= 2.0"
      list       = provider::semvers::pick(local.versions, "<= 2.0")
    },
    {
      constraint = "= 0.2.0"
      list       = provider::semvers::pick(local.versions, "= 0.2.0")
    },
  ]
}

# skip strings that are not valid semvers
output "semvers_list_picked_ignore_invalid" {
  value = provider::semvers::pick(concat(local.versions, ["develop-latest"]), "~> 0.2", true)
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
pick(versions list of string, constraint string, ignore_invalid bool...) list of string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `versions` (List of String) List of semver strings
1. `constraint` (String) Semver constraint
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `ignore_invalid` (Variadic, Boolean) Optional. When `true`, invalid semver strings in the list are skipped instead of returning an error. Skipped strings are logged at INFO level when `TF_LOG` is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
